data.description: Fully Upgraded | Corner Unit | Large Plot
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this 2 Bedroom villa, in The Springs 4.

Key Features:

* 2 Bedroom + Study
* 3 en-suite Bathrooms
* Fully Upgraded Villa
* BUA: 1,773 sqft
* Plot: 1828.36sqft
* Vacant
* Large Landscaped private garden
* Covered parking for two vehicles
* Bright and airy living and dining area
* Family-friendly gated community
* Shared swimming pool and children’s play area
* Community park with walking and jogging trails
* 24/7 security and maintenance
* Short distance to Springs Souk and retail outlets
* Nearby schools and nurseries
* Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and major highways

The Springs 4 is located within The Springs community, part of Emirates Living, Dubai. It is a well-established, gated residential neighborhood situated between Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, offering convenient access to key areas of the city.

The area is known for its family-friendly environment, landscaped lakes, walking trails, and proximity to schools, retail centers, and lifestyle amenities.
